'''Dapple''' is the leader of the pack of wolves affiliated with [[Elyas Machera]].

==Appearance==
Dapple is a she-wolf whose fur is a dozen shades of gray.

==Activities==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] is first learning about being a [[wolfbrother]], Dapple, [[Burn]], [[Hopper]], and [[Wind (wolf)|Wind]] speak with him.{{ref/book|1|23}} Dapple and her pack continue to follow Perrin, [[Egwene al'Vere]], and Elyas.{{ref/book|1|25}}{{ref/book|1|27}} When the humans see several flocks of ravens, Elyas asks Dapple to check their backtrail.{{ref/book|1|29}} Dapple tells Perrin that help is coming when he is captured by the [[Whitecloaks]].{{ref/book|1|38}}
